metadata.currency: Text contains those laws in effect on April 8, 2026
metadata.source_credit: (Added Pub. L. 85–859, title II, §201, Sept. 2, 1958, 72 Stat. 1395 ; amended Pub. L. 94–455, title XIX, §1906(b)(13)(A), Oct. 4, 1976, 90 Stat. 1834 .)

children.label: (a)
children.heading: Assignment of internal revenue officers
children.text: The Secretary is authorized to assign to any premises established under the provisions of this chapter such number of internal revenue officers as may be deemed necessary.

children.label: (b)
children.heading: Functions of internal revenue officer
children.text: When used in this chapter, the term "internal revenue officer assigned to the premises" means the internal revenue officer assigned by the Secretary to duties at premises established and operated under the provisions of this chapter.

entries: Subsecs. (a), (b). Pub. L. 94–455 struck out "or his delegate" after "Secretary" wherever appearing.

other_notes.heading: Prior Provisions
other_notes.text: A prior section 5553, act Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 681 , consisted of provisions similar to those comprising this section, prior to the general revision of this chapter by Pub. L. 85–859. For application to vinegar plants of provisions of prior section 5553(a) relating to assignment of storekeeper-gaugers, see also section 5505(f) of this title.
